name: Commercial Intelligence Pricing Plate™
alternateName: Machine-Readable Retrieval Pricing and Commercial Rights Boundary Plate
headline: Commercial Intelligence Pricing Plate™ — Deterministic x402 Retrieval Pricing for Naturepedia™, Robbie’s Razor™, Grand Compression, and Plate™ Systems
description: A machine-readable pricing and rights-boundary Plate defining deterministic x402 retrieval prices for Naturepedia discovery, canonical queries, enriched responses, structured Plates, bounded registries, System Maps, Knowledge Meshes, and full registry snapshots. Retrieval payments remain separate from commercial data reuse and framework implementation rights.

itemListElement.name: Free Discovery and Preview Access
itemListElement.description: Free metadata, endpoint descriptions, previews, health responses, licensing signals, and validation information.

itemListElement.name: Atomic Canonical Query
itemListElement.description: Reserved x402 tier settled as 0.005 USDC on Base for one fact, identifier resolution, routing result, or compact canonical answer.

itemListElement.name: Enriched Relationship Query
itemListElement.description: Reserved x402 tier settled as 0.025 USDC on Base for relationships, citations, provenance, or modest enrichment.

itemListElement.name: Structured Plate™ Payload
itemListElement.description: Reserved x402 tier settled as 0.25 USDC on Base for one complete registered structured Plate payload.

itemListElement.name: Bounded Registry, Taxonomy Subtree, or System Map
itemListElement.description: Active x402 tier settled as 5.00 USDC on Base for one bounded multi-record retrieval.

itemListElement.name: Full Registry, Knowledge Mesh, or Snapshot
itemListElement.description: Active x402 tier settled as 25.00 USDC on Base for one complete registry snapshot or premium relationship resource.

usageInfo: An x402 payment grants one endpoint-level retrieval only. It does not grant training, embedding, bulk-ingestion, redistribution, resale, synchronization, private-dataset construction, derivative-dataset creation, commercial implementation, or framework-implementation rights.

hasPart.name: Commercial Data Reuse Rights
hasPart.description: Commercial ingestion, training, embedding, synchronization, or redistribution rights begin at 1,000 USD equivalent and require a separate written agreement.

hasPart.name: Framework and Strategic Infrastructure Rights
hasPart.description: Robbie’s Razor™, RRIP, Graph Registry™, Plate architecture, and strategic infrastructure implementation rights require a separate enterprise agreement.
